title: Unit tests for stripQuery (src/common/redaction.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/common/strip-query.test.ts` for `stripQuery` in `src/common/redaction.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/common/redaction.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: a URL with no query or fragment is returned unchanged; a query string is dropped; a fragment is dropped; both together; a '?' or '#' at the very end; a relative path.
